sample_unit: simulated clinical scenarios (each completed twice by 3 early-career radiologists)

links.outcome: Guideline-concordant decisions by radiologists with vs without ChatGPT assistance
links.effect: Mean detailed compliance score rose from 1.697 to 1.900; minimal compliance from 90.89% to 98.70%; 30 scenario-level corrections (McNemar χ² = 27.03; p < 0.0001).
links.quote: ChatGPT-assisted reflective reasoning significantly improved guideline-concordant decision-making.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM-generated reasoning as a reflective cognitive support tool for early-career clinicians' procedural decisions

screen.reason: Prospective simulation study testing the impact of providing ChatGPT-generated reasoning to early-career radiologists versus unassisted decision-making on guideline concordance.

primary.practice: AI-assisted reflective reasoning / clinical decision support
